name: We the People - A Soliloquy
source:
Let's take a soft and slow journey to the land of mind, where you can contemplate life and more. 

[From [url=https://luui-arts.itch.io/we-the-people]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
让我们踏上一段柔和而缓慢的旅程，前往心灵之地，在那里你可以思考生活等等。

[来自[url=https://luui-arts.itch.io/we-the-people]Itch.io[/url]]
